mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_no, product_id, orderer_id, publisher_id, product_title_snapshot, unit_price_snapshot, order_status, payment_status, quantity, total_amount ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{productId}, #{ordererId}, #{publisherId}, #{productTitleSnapshot}, #{unitPriceSnapshot}, #{orderStatus}, #{paymentStatus}, #{quantity}, #{totalAmount} )
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET payment_status = 'PAID', order_status = 'WAITING_ACCEPTANCE', paid_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND orderer_id = #{buyerId} AND order_status = 'WAITING_PAYMENT' AND payment_status = 'UNPAID'

UPDATE orders SET order_status = 'IN_PROGRESS', accepted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND order_status = 'WAITING_ACCEPTANCE' AND payment_status = 'PAID'

UPDATE orders SET order_status = 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION', submitted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND order_status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
UPDATE orders SET order_status = 'COMPLETED', confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND orderer_id = #{buyerId} AND order_status = 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION'

UPDATE orders SET order_status = 'CANCELLED', payment_status = 'REFUNDED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND orderer_id = #{buyerId} AND order_status = 'WAITING_ACCEPTANCE' AND payment_status = 'PAID'
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, product_id, orderer_id, publisher_id, product_title_snapshot, unit_price_snapshot, quantity, total_amount, order_status, payment_status, created_at FROM orders WHERE orderer_id = #{userId} OR publisher_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, order_no, product_id, orderer_id, publisher_id, product_title_snapshot, unit_price_snapshot, quantity, total_amount, order_status, payment_status, created_at, paid_at, accepted_at, submitted_at, confirmed_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE id = #{id} AND ( orderer_id = #{userId} OR publisher_id = #{userId} )
SELECT id, orderer_id, publisher_id, total_amount, order_status, payment_status FROM orders WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
